run_pseudo_decomp_variable: run the pseudo decomposition script to find nearest neighbor question decompositions for HotpotQA splits
create_vectorize: create a function that vectorizes a question string into a spaCy doc embedding scaled by token length
build_load_compositional_questions: build a function that loads HotpotQA compositional questions and converts them to L2-normalized vectors
test_load_single_hop_qs: test the function that loads SQuAD single-hop questions with length filtering and optional cached results
summarize_main: summarize the main CLI entry point that performs beam search pseudo-decomposition and saves results to files
